# YXO (Young Extraordinary Odyssey)

> YXO runs full-day workshops, in person and live online, that teach teens ages 13 to 17 to think bigger, use AI as a tool for their own ideas, and start building a personal roadmap for an extraordinary life. Website: https://yxo.world

## Upcoming workshops

- Virtual, live on Zoom: the YXO virtual cohort runs Saturday, December 5, 2026, 10 AM to 4 PM Eastern. $100 USD per student. Register at https://yxo.world/#register

## What teens leave with

- AI fluency
- An entrepreneurial mindset
- A personal roadmap
- A certificate of completion

## How the day works

Methods borrowed from psychology, theatre, improv, and play: an opening circle, mindset shifts and fear setting, a resilience lab, a presentation on exponential technologies and solving a problem, an extraordinary life meditation, a crazy ideas brainstorm, a startup lab where teens build their own company and website with AI, company pitches, and a wrap-up with certificates. The virtual cohort runs live on Zoom; teens need a laptop with a camera and microphone, a charger and good wifi. The workshop is teens only.

## People

- Lily Safrani: founder of YXO.
- Natasha Tsakos: workshop mentor. Award-winning director, performer, and producer working at the intersection of arts, technology, innovation, and space exploration. Founder of SPACE WONDERS. TEDx talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEmjcz5LS-o
- Workshops are led by Singularity University alumni.
- Team page: https://yxo.world/team
